title: Study of the Efficacy of the Treatment of Sleep Apnea Syndrome by CPAP in Pharmacoresistant Epilepsy
brief_summary: Study of the Efficacy of the Treatment of Sleep Apnea Syndrome by CPAP in Pharmacoresistant Epilepsy. The primary goal is to evaluate the efficacity after 3 months of obstructive sleep apnea syndrome treatment by CPAP on the epilepsy seizures frequency.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female age ≥ 18.
* Patient suffering of pharmacoresistant epilepsy.
* Frequency of epilepsy crisis : minimum 4 per month.
* Antiepileptic drug on a stable dose for at least 2 months.
* SA-SDQ score ≥ 25.
* Written informed consent obtained.
* Patient affiliated with a social security regimen.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant females (female subjects who are lactating are not excluded).
* Anterior CPAP treatment.
* Central apnea \>20% during the initial polysomnography.
* Mental retardation or severe cognitive impairment.
* Presence of pseudo-crisis.
